summary: The default Elemental build with Mana Tide Totem for the group, cast at 10% mana.
rotation: Pre-pull: Lightning Shield at -5.4s, Mana Spring Totem at -3.9s, Lightning Bolt at -2.9s (lands 0.1s after the pull), Searing Totem at -0.9s
Lightning Mastery and other cooldowns (Demonic Rune, Major Mana Potion) when ready
Mana Tide Totem at 10% mana or less
Mana Spring Totem when it and Mana Tide are down, with at least 20s left
Searing Totem when it is down, with at least 20s left
Flame Shock when its DoT is down, with at least 9s left
Earth Shock when a Lightning Bolt would not land before the end
Lightning Shield when it is down, above 50% mana with at least 60s left. Its orbs fire at the boss when the shaman takes a hit, about 2 a minute.
Lightning Bolt rank 8 once mana won't last the fight at 20 mana a second, counting Mana Tide's 1160 while it's ready. Under Clearcasting, the top rank, since it's free.
Lightning Bolt rank 10 as filler. No Chain Lightning on one target.
caveats: The Water Shield point goes unused, because Lightning Shield stays up.
Lightning Bolt (0.78 of Era's base), Lightning Overload (30%), Call of Thunder and the shocks take the November 2 notes' values. Client 1.60.1.70753 doesn't carry them yet.
Wears The Five Thunders 6-piece (Phase 0 list). The 4-piece proc rate (The Furious Storm) is unconfirmed, and the 5-piece's disarm isn't simmed.
Only one 2% crit elixir. Owl on top of Sages would add about 10 DPS.
Assumed: the shaman takes 2 damage hits a minute. Each one fires Lightning Shield.
Eye of the Storm 3 stops 70% of the pushback from the 2 hits a minute.
Uses Major Mana Potion instead of Caustic Smog Potion. That's -4.3 / +1.8 / +27.2 DPS at 120s / 180s / 300s.
notes: mksettings -spec ele_mana_tide -apl level60_mana_tide (standards 23: every shaman drops its own party totems; the raid has none, the shaman drops Mana Spring Totem itself) (its own consumes, the Major Mana Potion, ManaTideConsumes); race SkyborneWindshaper (the best race since client 70425's Wind Blessed 3% haste). The raid's Sunder Armor ramps since 2026-10-31 (standard 32, mksettings -sunder ramp): a warrior tank stacks it from the pull and one DPS warrior casts it on its first GCD. Phase 0 step 4 (2026-11-24): the Phase 0 set (mksettings -spec ele_mana_tide -gear level60_phase0_ele, the same talents and APL), was level60_phase1_synthetic at 959.6. Spell hit is 12% against the 16% cap with Tidal Focus 5/5. lightningBoltDownrankManaPerSec 16 is +0.7 at 300 s only, 26 loses, one rank down ties: the preset's stays.
